name: Cloaking Device
notes: Turns near-invisible while still. Breaks on firing.

name: Evasive Dash
notes: Short burst dash on charges.

name: Grappling Hook
notes: Swing/pull to a surface on a cooldown.

name: Dematerializer
notes: Temporarily deletes a panel of terrain.

name: Guardian Turret
notes: Placed auto-turret that fires on enemies in range.

name: Heal Beam
notes: Continuous beam locked onto one ally. Cannot heal the user — see csv/heals/.

name: Shockwave
notes: Cone blast that shoves players and objects.

name: Recon Senses
notes: Periodic enemy reveal. Roster entry only; availability by season not researched.

name: Charge 'N' Slam
notes: Charging shoulder rush ending in a ground slam.

name: Goo Gun
notes: Sprays goo blobs — cover

name: Mesh Shield
notes: Projected shield held in front of the user. Blocks from the front only, so it is cover for the user and anyone behind them.

name: Winch Claw
notes: Reels in players and objects.

name: Breach Charge
notes: Remote-detonated wall charge.

name: Gateway
notes: Paired portals.

name: Glitch Grenade
notes: Disables equipment and abilities in its radius.

name: Gravity Vortex
notes: Pulls players and objects toward a point.

name: H+ Infuser
notes: Hitscan heal shots. Cannot heal the user — see csv/heals/.

name: Sonar Grenade
notes: Pulses enemy positions through walls.

name: Nullifier
notes: Zone that suppresses equipment and abilities.

name: Thermal Bore
notes: Burns a hole through a surface.

name: Thermal Vision
notes: Sees heat signatures through smoke and walls for a short time.

name: Tracking Dart
notes: Marks a hit enemy for the squad.

name: Vanishing Bomb
notes: Cloaks everyone in its blast.

name: APS Turret
notes: Shoots down incoming projectiles in a radius.

name: Breach Drill
notes: Drills through a surface after a delay.

name: Data Reshaper
notes: Converts an enemy placeable into a harmless prop.

name: Defibrillator
notes: Fast revive of a downed teammate. Does nothing for a fighter still standing.

name: Gas Mine
notes: Proximity mine that releases a gas cloud.

name: Glitch Trap
notes: Proximity trap that glitches whoever sets it off.

name: Hover Pad
notes: Placed pad that holds players aloft.

name: Jump Pad
notes: Placed pad that launches players.

name: Zipline
notes: Deployable line between two anchors.

name: Anti-Gravity Cube
notes: Field that lifts players and objects.

name: Barricade
notes: Deployable wall panel. Cover rather than a shield — modelled as neither until its health is recorded.

name: C4
notes: Remote-detonated explosive.

name: Dome Shield
notes: Deployable bubble that blocks fire from every direction. Anyone inside is covered; anyone inside can also shoot out.

name: Heal Ball
notes: Placed emitter healing everyone in its radius — see csv/heals/.

name: Lockbolt
notes: Tethers a target to a surface.

name: Pyro Mine
notes: Proximity mine that sets off a fire burst.

name: RPG-7
notes: Single-shot rocket launcher.

name: Flashbang
notes: Blinds and deafens in its radius.

name: Frag Grenade
notes: Standard fragmentation grenade.

name: Gas Grenade
notes: Leaves a damaging gas cloud.

name: Goo Grenade
notes: Bursts into goo blocks — instant cover.

name: Pyro Grenade
notes: Bursts into a fire pool.

name: Smoke Grenade
notes: Blocks line of sight.

name: Proximity Sensor
notes: Placed sensor that reveals nearby enemies.

name: Explosive Mine
notes: Proximity mine dealing burst damage.

name: Heal Canister
notes: Arena pickup rather than a loadout slot — see csv/heals/.
